scope: Complete spoken tutorial and browser-wide virtual cursor reading and quick keys.

topics.title: Rebuilt audio tutorial
details: Nine courses cover Getting started, Word processor, Notepad, Email, Web browser, Radio, Podcasts, Options, and Help and updates. Each offers task walkthroughs, a titled lesson index, detailed documented commands, Find lesson and Explain command. Options includes every control in all twelve categories. Fictional action simulations are removed.

Say Start tutorial, choose a course, then Next lesson, Previous lesson, Repeat, Lesson list, List commands, or Courses. Escape returns one level; Main menu leaves. Long command explanations support Continue reading. Tutorial requests explain app commands without changing real work.

topics.title: Virtual cursor and form editing
details: Arrows and quick keys stay in page reading mode when moving past fields. Tab, Enter, Edit current field or explicit dictation starts editing. Escape restores quick keys immediately. The virtual page surface is read-only so letters cannot alter its text.

topics.title: Keyboard focus and complete page text
details: Quick keys and page arrows are handled across Companion window controls even when focus has strayed to command entry. Alt T explicitly enables typed commands. Ordinary text between links is covered by regression tests across page layouts and all four supported browsers.

topics.title: Consumer verification
details: Added complete tutorial navigation and reference coverage, real-work isolation, Windows keyboard focus regressions, immediate Escape then H, and plain-text arrow traversal. Control Alt Success live audit now verifies body-text coverage, with contact submissions kept unsubmitted.
